name: Mixpanel
symbol: Ingestion API /import response for wrong-residency data
title: Mixpanel: Ingestion API /import response for wrong-residency data (behavior change)
summary: Starting December 14, 2026, the Ingestion API /import endpoint will return a 403 response code when you send data to an ingestion server that doesn't match your project's data residency
replacement: Send data to the Ingestion API Server URL matching your project's data residency: api.mixpanel.com/import (US), api-eu.mixpanel.com/import (EU), or api-in.mixpanel.com/import (IN).
